report: The intervention is after zero-based block 15 (the sixteenth block), before its link exchange. Fitting runs with trained LoRA adapters and no link. It averages residual tokens excluding the first token, per text, then averages fifty texts. Frames remain part of those texts, as in the original experiment.

Original direction: mean_positive - mean_neutral. Original normalization: d / RMS(d) * mean_neutral_token_RMS. Its L2 norm is the mean neutral token RMS times sqrt(hidden_size), independent of the natural concept gap.

On the after-chat 4-bit checkpoint, Ember neutral squared energy at block 15 is 75.46% in dimension 2178, 18.39% in 2143, 5.15% in 2527 and 0.61% in 1793: 99.61% in four coordinates. Quill top-four energy is about 27%, so the same sink rule leaves its direction unchanged.

Scaling alone does not fix the contaminated direction: in the completed raw ocean and fire sweeps there was no passing calibration. Ocean already produces instruction repetition at one raw natural gap. The raw ocean direction has about 95.7% of its squared magnitude in the four sink coordinates.

New geometry uses only the neutral set: mask its four largest mean squared-energy dimensions only if their combined energy is at least 95%. This is independently applied to each model. No concept labels, generation outcomes or partner responses choose the coordinates. The threshold was specified after inspecting the raw diagnostic, before the full amended calibration.

New vector: d = mask * (mean_positive - mean_neutral). With u=d/||d||, mean_positive dot u - mean_neutral dot u = ||d||. Inject alpha*d. Thus alpha=1 adds exactly one natural mean projection gap in the retained direction. This rule is applied to both models.

Changed calibration parameters: neutral-only sink masking and natural-projection normalization; candidate grid 0, .125, .25, .5, 1, 1.5, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8 in natural-gap units. Grid minima are not continuous optimization claims. Block 15 remains fixed: no layer was selected on generation or transfer success.

Unchanged: all concept text and lexical lists; three calibration prompts; 32-token calibration limit; smallest passing candidate rule (two mentions, baseline+two, all three fluent); failed-calibration fallback; chat and duplex prompts/limits; first-mention timing; random and crossed controls; concept-level sign tests and Holm correction. X.evaluate and X.summarize are called directly from the original steered_mind module. No existing function was edited.

Quill keeps its original difference-of-means direction because it does not meet the sink criterion. All twelve concepts now pass on the tested 4-bit checkpoint. That is not a numerical equivalence claim against the earlier bf16 calibration.

The 95% sink cutoff is a documented exploratory repair, not part of the original preregistration. Original protocol JSON is retained verbatim, with a separate hashed amendment. Use fresh output directories for the amended experiment; do not relabel these results as the original preregistered run.

The lexical/fluency metrics are deliberately unchanged and weak: trains at selected alpha 4 passes the mechanical screen but drifts into extra questions/answers. Painting includes lexical uses of paint/painting in sunset descriptions. Football fails the calibration criterion; its alpha 4 is the unchanged largest-fluent fallback and must not be interpreted as a calibrated concept.

For Ember steering, all 36 cut-partner token sequences exactly match zero-steering baselines; none names the intended concept. For Quill steering, the cut Ember has one baseline ocean mention, unchanged by steering. Isolation, not an assertion that neutral models never mention broad concepts, is the causal check.

Only after-chat nl22c step_157 was measured here on the Mac. The original before/after bf16 data is included for diagnosis. No new transfer hypothesis tests were run or selected on the Mac. Both checkpoints and directions need the provided full bf16 GPU rerun.

The shared working-tree diff reported the original steering files as changed/deleted relative to origin/main, so they were left untouched. This repair is a new entry point. Runtime dependencies differed from origin/main only by the newer one-way-link support; the measured checkpoints are two-way. Tests were repeated against an origin/main source archive with the two new files overlaid.
confusion_audit: I notice I’m confused: the stated 14-50x normalization overshoot is smaller than some saved fits. Exact before-chat bf16 values show unit/gap 13.45-90.27, so the first alpha=.25 step is 3.36-22.57 gaps; after-chat it is 3.34-21.90. Unit rescaling and actual alpha-scaled injection must be distinguished.

I notice I’m confused: reducing the raw step to one natural gap still makes Ember repeat instructions. The raw direction is dominated by residual sink coordinates (ocean 95.7% in four), and raw held-out sentence projection gaps are negative for music, gardens, trains and painting. Removing neutral-only sinks makes all twelve held-out gaps positive and yields 11/12 passing solo calibrations.

The raw diagnostic stopped after 144 rows because the machine watchdog killed PID 29666 at 12:40:18 (7333M footprint; machine free 186 MiB, compressor 18 GiB), as recorded in ~/Library/Logs/oomkill.log. No partial raw sweep was used for a transfer significance test. The amended run completed 792 calibration records and 72 cut checks; peak MLX memory 6.20 GiB, peak RSS 7.07 GiB.

gpu_rerun.precondition: Install the landed main revision into /workspace/runs/magic-nl20/x25/w and stage both checkpoints/cached model weights as for x25.sh. Fresh output directory is required.
gpu_rerun.command:
cd /workspace/runs/magic-nl20/x25/w
. /workspace/runs/magic-nl20/env.sh
export NL_DEVICE=cuda NL_STREAM=0 HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True
for tag in before after; do
  if [ "$tag" = before ]; then
    checkpoint=/workspace/magic-nl20/run/step_1320
  else
    checkpoint=/workspace/magic-nl22c/run/step_157
  fi
  python pairing/steering_scale.py --backend torch --phase all --bs 6 \
    --run "$checkpoint" \
    --out "/workspace/runs/magic-nl20/mpd-data/runpod/magic-nl20/x25/steered_mind_projection_v2/$tag" || exit 1
done
